before.dolichol_route_evidence: S. cerevisiae: polyprenol is reduced to dolichol through Tda5 (NAD+), Dfg10 and Env9 (NADPH) (Hanaoka et al. 2026, PMID 42201967); SRD5A3/Dfg10 needed for dolichol (PMID 20637498); Sec59 phosphorylates dolichol. Y. lipolytica: DFG10 candidate ortholog YALI1E09357g by KEGG orthology only.
before.dolichol_route_evidence_tier: S. cerevisiae experiment plus Y. lipolytica orthology; no Y. lipolytica dolichol data
before.dolichol_route_limits: Lumped and gene-less; not mass-balanced (m2019 has no formula, m499 has a farnesol formula); the polyprenyl-PP phosphatase is uncharacterised; Tda5 and Env9 orthologs not identified; NUS1 ortholog YALI1F26726g not in the model.

after.dolichol_route_evidence: Human DHRSX is an NAD+-dependent polyprenol dehydrogenase and an NADPH-dependent dolichal reductase, and SRD5A3 reduces polyprenal (Wilson et al. 2024, PMID 38821050). In S. cerevisiae Tda5 is the functional DHRSX ortholog (Hanaoka et al. 2026, PMID 42201967), Env9 reduces dolichal with NADPH (Wilson et al. 2026 preprint) and Dfg10 reduces polyprenal (KEGG R13444, NADPH). Y. lipolytica: DFG10 candidate ortholog YALI1E09357g by KEGG orthology only.
after.dolichol_route_evidence_tier: S. cerevisiae experiment plus Y. lipolytica orthology; no Y. lipolytica dolichol data
after.dolichol_route_limits: Lumped and gene-less; not mass-balanced (m2019 has no formula, m499 has a farnesol formula); the polyprenyl-PP phosphatase is uncharacterised; the NAD+ of the oxidation is shown for human DHRSX, not for yeast Tda5; Tda5 and Env9 orthologs not identified; NUS1 ortholog YALI1F26726g not in the model.
